protocol.attribution: WikiText contributors and source Wikipedia authors; see pinned dataset card
protocol.selection: evenly spaced nonoverlapping windows in newline-joined split rows; no padding; reset context per window
protocol.scope: sampled encyclopedia language modeling; not full WikiText perplexity or general task acceptance

screen.status: provisional engineering screen inherited before this run

numerical_control.rationale: Check local arithmetic directly; log probabilities remove arbitrary per-position logit offsets. Bound every vocabulary probability ratio by exp(0.001), plus exact decisions and tighter mean target loss.
numerical_control.prior_run: 20260909-wikitext-sampled remains rejected under its original raw-logit criterion

contract.signed_weight_representation: differential pair; effective multilevel weight precision is assumed, not demonstrated
contract.input_representation: signed DAC voltage assumed; no input bit serialization
contract.readout: analog differential subtraction before one signed ADC per logical column
contract.adc_range: activation bound times maximum column L1 weight norm within each tile
contract.accumulation: digital float32 sum across row tiles and digital bias addition

energy_latency.energy_equation: E_projection = N_DAC*e_DAC + N_ADC*e_ADC + N_array*e_array + N_add*e_add + bytes*e_move; add programming/calibration amortization
energy_latency.break_even: E_projection plus integration overhead must be below same-target digital projection energy
